name: znetwork_get_player_name_by_key
description: zNetwork::GetPlayerNameByKey finds a player record by key, copies the recovered playerName field into the caller buffer with strncpy, and returns whether a record was found.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent zNetwork player-record/source-cluster pass.

The native player-record accessor smoke verifies successful name copy for a matching key and zero return for a missing key.
